about: Decisions a person made on what the catalog build left for review (docs/catalog-review.md), so each build applies them instead of listing them again. A decision only chooses among what the sources say, or says how a source is read; it never adds a value no source gives (docs/catalog-sources.md, "Decisions"). `form`: a cultivar with no page of its own, whose species' sources list it as a tree: the forms it takes, primary first, each listed by a species source. `nativeShown`: a plant the catalog calls exotic that Kew's checklist has native in some states: shown native there all the same. `kewNames`: names Kew's checklist could read two ways, checked to be read as Kew's accepted name, whose authors (`author`) it records. `genusPage`: a plant read from NC State's page for its whole genus, the facts checked to fit it.

lagerstroemia-natchez-muskogee-tonto.note: 'Natchez' and 'Muskogee' grow into trees, 'Tonto' stays shrub-sized: they could be separate records (docs/future-ideas.md)

lantana-camara-miss-huff-hardy.note: Kew has it native only in Puerto Rico; when the catalog's North America-wide native status comes from Kew, the territories stay out of North America
